confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mumbai price levels, not live listings or booking pages; USD values are sensitive to rupee exchange-rate assumptions. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain given property variation and possible monsoon-season softness in July. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local price relationship to beer (bar drinks roughly two to two-and-a-half times a beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange rates page; two separate searches returned the same 14 October 2026 4pm value, but I did not open the page or the F11.1 data file directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asia, reasoned from general knowledge of large Indian metro pricing (Delhi and Bengaluru as peers), with Mumbai-specific adjustments for hotel rates and state alcohol taxes. No single comparable city was used.
